steps.title: A first useful set of present subjunctive patterns
steps.body: Use the subjunctive in a limited set of common patterns when the phrase expresses a need, wish, preference or reaction and the subject changes: Il faut que le centre ouvre plus tôt; je souhaite que vous répondiez. Learn whole useful frames, not a long trigger list. Common forms include soit, ait, fasse, puisse and regular forms such as parle. The infinitive is normally used when the subject stays the same: Je veux participer; compare Je veux que tu participes. This is an introduction; later B2 work develops a wider range and nuance.

steps.title: A first useful set of present subjunctive patterns
rows: Il faut que la salle soit accessible.
The room needs to be accessible.
Je souhaite que le centre prolonge ses heures.
I hope the centre extends its hours.
I hope to take part in the workshop.

steps.prompt: Complete: Il faut que la salle ___ accessible.
steps.explain: After il faut que with a different subject, use subjunctive soit.

steps.prompt: Choose the natural sentence when both actions have the same subject.
options: Je souhaite que je participe à la rencontre.
Je souhaite que participer à la rencontre.
Je souhaite participer à la rencontre.
Je souhaite participe à la rencontre.
steps.explain: With the same subject, the infinitive is the natural pattern here.

steps.prompt: Complete: Je suis contente que vous ___ disponibles.
steps.explain: The reaction phrase with a different subject takes subjunctive soyez.
